faqs.question: Is this kind of marketing affordable for a small Verona business?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build plans around your budget, and many Verona businesses start with just one service, like a Google Business Profile or social media, before adding more.

faqs.question: Are your indoor billboard screens in Verona?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Our screen network currently runs in neighboring West Orange and in Bloomfield. Verona businesses can advertise on those screens today, and Verona venues with steady foot traffic can apply to host a screen.

faqs.question: Can you promote our event at Verona Park or in town?
faqs.answer: Yes. Geofencing and social media ads can target people near an event location and in the surrounding area before and during the event.
